event: Low and ready he crosses to the wreck, the lantern out ahead, his own heat held at the wick.

changes.note: Heat drawn from his well and held ready at the wick
The leap's grind still in his knees

event: He lifts a palm-sized clouded lens, colder than the rock; his sense slides off it.

make.title: Clouded lens
make.description: A palm-sized glass lens gone the grey-white of a blind eye, and colder than stone.

event: Item: Clouded lens, recovered from the Host's seat.
He gathers the slack grey mantle of folded light, weightless, and pockets it.

make.title: Woven-light mantle
make.description: A mantle of woven brightness gone slack and grey, shed in one piece and weightless.

event: Item: Woven-light mantle, recovered from the Host's seat.
The grey husk he leaves where it fell: cooling weight the forge has no use for.

memory.fact: The husk of the Host's true form is cold and holds nothing a forge can use.

event: His lantern finds the other heat: a low, wrong-jointed cold thing, hurt along one side.

memory.fact: With the haven dead, the Welcomer's kind have no woven face to wear.
Nothing weaves the False Haven now, so it and its wounded remain as they are left.

event: It gathers its ruined weight to move, and his fire is already drawn back to throw.
